named_results.statement: Ordinary universal cover of connected normal projective complex X has semialgebraic projective-open presentation iff it is biholomorphic to D times C^m times F, with D bounded symmetric and F simply connected normal projective.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: m>=0 and point factors allowed;F may be singular;ordinary complex openness;presentation and deck maps need not be algebraic or definable. Full group input requires separate SpecialAbelianity;full chain unknown.
named_results.conditions: m>=0 and point factors allowed;F may be singular;ordinary complex openness;presentation and deck maps need not be algebraic or definable. Full group input requires separate SpecialAbelianity;full chain unknown.

named_results.statement: The product projection to D times C^m is a Remmert reduction with connected compact F fibres, so the cover is holomorphically convex and is Stein exactly when F is a point.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Normal projective source and classified semialgebraic ordinary universal cover;Stein factor/base distinction is intrinsic,not an arbitrary semialgebraic numerical quotient.
named_results.conditions: Normal projective source and classified semialgebraic ordinary universal cover;Stein factor/base distinction is intrinsic,not an arbitrary semialgebraic numerical quotient.

named_results.statement: For a smooth closed aspherical projective complex n-fold with this cover, L2 Betti numbers vanish outside degree n; a positive affine factor gives vanishing in every degree.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Smooth/aspherical/closed required. Amenable normal subgroup and locally symmetric harmonic-analysis inputs are separate;not finite-data Betti-number computation.
named_results.conditions: Smooth/aspherical/closed required. Amenable normal subgroup and locally symmetric harmonic-analysis inputs are separate;not finite-data Betti-number computation.

named_results.statement: A finitely generated virtually abelian fibre kernel has a characteristic finite-index free abelian subgroup Kprime;quotient U/Kprime has connected normal projective fibres with fundamental group Kprime.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Intersect finitely many subgroups of bounded index;normality in the whole deck group follows from characteristic property. Contractibility of transverse base identifies each fibre pi1 with total pi1.
named_results.conditions: Intersect finitely many subgroups of bounded index;normality in the whole deck group follows from characteristic property. Contractibility of transverse base identifies each fibre pi1 with total pi1.

named_results.statement: Construct a smooth proper family of abelian varieties and its torsor as relative Albanese;fibre maps induce integral fundamental-group isomorphisms.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Kprime free abelian;actual simultaneous smooth proper resolution and saturated integral H1 local systems. Normal projective Albanese has finite H1 kernel,so torsionfreeness is essential to upgrade. No chosen global origin or prior isotriviality.
named_results.conditions: Kprime free abelian;actual simultaneous smooth proper resolution and saturated integral H1 local systems. Normal projective Albanese has finite H1 kernel,so torsionfreeness is essential to upgrade. No chosen global origin or prior isotriviality.

named_results.title_tex: The proper map to the affine base
named_results.statement: There is an equivariant proper flat surjection j:U->T with T biholomorphic to M times C^a and connected simply connected normal projective fibres;deck action on T is proper and cocompact with finite isotropy permitted.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Entire fibrewise universal pullback must satisfy KPv2Theorem20. Fibrewise flatness then base change. Cartan/Oka over contractible Stein M trivializes the lifted affine bundle,not necessarily the original torus family. A fibre-ample invariant line bundle is supplied.
named_results.conditions: Entire fibrewise universal pullback must satisfy KPv2Theorem20. Fibrewise flatness then base change. Cartan/Oka over contractible Stein M trivializes the lifted affine bundle,not necessarily the original torus family. A fibre-ample invariant line bundle is supplied.

named_results.statement: A nonempty closed invariant finite-CW-homotopy subset A of a contractible smooth T homeomorphic to R^b is all T.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Countable discrete group,proper cocompact diffeomorphism action;finite stabilizers allowed. Ordered locally finite translated homotopies give controlled proper homotopy and one-point degree contradiction;quotient need not be a covering.
named_results.conditions: Countable discrete group,proper cocompact diffeomorphism action;finite stabilizers allowed. Ordered locally finite translated homotopies give controlled proper homotopy and one-point degree contradiction;quotient need not be a covering.

named_results.statement: Integral fixed-dimension/degree cycles entirely contained in U form a semialgebraic Chow locus homeomorphic to the parameter T of compact fibres.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Fibre normality/connectedness gives irreducibility and reduced cycles;Stein base forces each compact irreducible cycle into one fibre. Inverse continuity uses transverse intersection,not only bijection. Compactification need not be smooth.
named_results.conditions: Fibre normality/connectedness gives irreducibility and reduced cycles;Stein base forces each compact irreducible cycle into one fibre. Inverse continuity uses transverse intersection,not only bijection. Compactification need not be smooth.

named_results.title_tex: Integral marking of polarized isomorphism classes
named_results.statement: For fixed polarized fibre,its polarized-isomorphism class is semialgebraic in the Chow model of T.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Graph-degree bound from integral Chern intersections;normality turns finite bijective graph projections into isomorphisms. Integral c1 marking constant on finitely many connected components and Pic0(F)=0 for simply connected normal projective F. No definability of the line bundle or extension to compactification assumed.
named_results.conditions: Graph-degree bound from integral Chern intersections;normality turns finite bijective graph projections into isomorphisms. Integral c1 marking constant on finitely many connected components and Pic0(F)=0 for simply connected normal projective F. No definability of the line bundle or extension to compactification assumed.

named_results.statement: The universal cover is biholomorphic to M times C^a times a fixed simply connected normal projective F.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Each polarized class invariant semialgebraic,its closure finite CW;closed rigidity forces density and finite cells exclude two disjoint dense classes. Hilbert orbit gives local holomorphic triviality also for singular F;Oka trivializes a principal stabilizer bundle over contractible Stein T.
named_results.conditions: Each polarized class invariant semialgebraic,its closure finite CW;closed rigidity forces density and finite cells exclude two disjoint dense classes. Hilbert orbit gives local holomorphic triviality also for singular F;Oka trivializes a principal stabilizer bundle over contractible Stein T.

named_results.statement: D times C^m times projective F has a semialgebraic projective-open presentation.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Borel orbit in projective compact dual,real algebraic semisimple orbit image by real QE,and usual affine chart. Concerns biholomorphism type only;no algebraicity of deck maps. Point factors permitted.
named_results.conditions: Borel orbit in projective compact dual,real algebraic semisimple orbit image by real QE,and usual affine chart. Concerns biholomorphism type only;no algebraicity of deck maps. Point factors permitted.

named_results.statement: Every bounded holomorphic function on a connected regular cover of a compact connected Kahler manifold with virtually abelian deck group is constant.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Pass finite cover to abelian group;positive harmonic extreme rays transform by characters,dlog h descends and compact integration kills its energy. Not Liouville for arbitrary noncompact manifolds or arbitrary deck groups.
named_results.conditions: Pass finite cover to abelian group;positive harmonic extreme rays transform by characters,dlog h descends and compact integration kills its energy. Not Liouville for arbitrary noncompact manifolds or arbitrary deck groups.

named_results.statement: For proper holomorphic q and meromorphic projective-valued map,if a level projected from its holomorphic open region has countable base image,that image is locally finite.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Resolve the graph;proper fibres and analytic-component local finiteness essential. Whole-level equality and all points of the open region must be kept;countable alone does not imply discrete.
named_results.conditions: Resolve the graph;proper fibres and analytic-component local finiteness essential. Whole-level equality and all points of the open region must be kept;countable alone does not imply discrete.

named_results.statement: Very-general lifted core levels have countable locally finite images in the intrinsic quotient M.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Special smooth compact core fibre has entire ordinary pi1 virtually abelian by external input;bounded coordinate functions constant on its regular lifted components. Extension across full compact incidence restores level equality including divisor points.
named_results.conditions: Special smooth compact core fibre has entire ordinary pi1 virtually abelian by external input;bounded coordinate functions constant on its regular lifted components. Extension across full compact incidence restores level equality including divisor points.

named_results.statement: The descended transverse image Lambda is discrete in Aut(M) and cocompact.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Locally finite closed core-level images have dense union;connected identity component of closure fixes them pointwise and hence fixes M. Compactness of projective quotient gives cocompactness after discreteness,not before intrinsic quotient construction.
named_results.conditions: Locally finite closed core-level images have dense union;connected identity component of closure fixes them pointwise and hence fixes M. Compactness of projective quotient gives cocompactness after discreteness,not before intrinsic quotient construction.

named_results.statement: Lambda has a torsionfree finite-index subgroup acting freely on M;the associated finite deck-group replacement gives normal projective unramified cover of X.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Apply Selberg to Ad(Lambda),without faithfulness assumption. Finite isotropy fixing all complex-spanning fields has identity derivative then identity. Torsionfreeness separately uses contractible finite-dimensional free resolution;projectivity via Riemann existence and ample pullback.
named_results.conditions: Apply Selberg to Ad(Lambda),without faithfulness assumption. Finite isotropy fixing all complex-spanning fields has identity derivative then identity. Torsionfreeness separately uses contractible finite-dimensional free resolution;projectivity via Riemann existence and ample pullback.

named_results.statement: The intrinsic transverse M is a bounded symmetric domain,with a point permitted.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: After free finite-index action,compact contractible quotient has positive canonical bundle. Nadel-Frankel splitting leaves discrete residual factor;complete Bergman product metric and no Euclidean factor preserve distributions,then complex-spanning complete fields kill residual dimension. Independent route from bounded manuscript Vey proof.
named_results.conditions: After free finite-index action,compact contractible quotient has positive canonical bundle. Nadel-Frankel splitting leaves discrete residual factor;complete Bergman product metric and no Euclidean factor preserve distributions,then complex-spanning complete fields kill residual dimension. Independent route from bounded manuscript Vey proof.

named_results.statement: A connected regular cover of a smooth projective variety that is projective-open with analytic complement has virtually abelian deck group.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Core extension over compactification,very-general compact level components give finite monodromy index. Punctured core fibre pi1 maps through compact fibre because original map extends;SpecialAbelianity required. Not all open manifolds or singular compact bases.
named_results.conditions: Core extension over compactification,very-general compact level components give finite monodromy index. Punctured core fibre pi1 maps through compact fibre because original map extends;SpecialAbelianity required. Not all open manifolds or singular compact bases.

named_results.statement: After the free transverse finite-cover replacement,the kernel of deck map to Lambda is finitely generated virtually abelian.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Leaf is a regular compactifiable cover of a smooth projective fibre in the resolution quotient;apply compactifiable-cover result. Finite generation follows from compact fibre pi1 surjection,not from being an arbitrary normal subgroup of a finitely generated group.
named_results.conditions: Leaf is a regular compactifiable cover of a smooth projective fibre in the resolution quotient;apply compactifiable-cover result. Finite generation follows from compact fibre pi1 surjection,not from being an arbitrary normal subgroup of a finitely generated group.

named_results.statement: At a generic fixed real centre,each accessible seed component inside any fixed finite normalized ball lies within any prescribed eta-neighbourhood of closure of the marked open kernel for sufficiently small scale.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: The original locally pseudoconvex S stays fixed as centres move;seed has uniform initial room. Ratio limit G is everywhere invertible block diagonal with real-polynomial blocks depending only on later real variables. All bounded recentrings and fixed finite Ck tests required;threshold depends centre,radius,eta.
named_results.conditions: The original locally pseudoconvex S stays fixed as centres move;seed has uniform initial room. Ratio limit G is everywhere invertible block diagonal with real-polynomial blocks depending only on later real variables. All bounded recentrings and fixed finite Ck tests required;threshold depends centre,radius,eta.

named_results.statement: A subanalytic parameterized one-variable germ has generic jointly analytic parametrization after finite power ramification,with convergence on smaller parameter boxes.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Finite requested functions/jets may share a ramification and generic box. Countably many tests permit countable exceptional union,not a single common ramification or neighbourhood for every test.
named_results.conditions: Finite requested functions/jets may share a ramification and generic box. Countably many tests permit countable exceptional union,not a single common ramification or neighbourhood for every test.

named_results.statement: Selected accessible paths can be replaced by paths with uniform real-centre derivative and complex-neighbourhood controls after a common time schedule.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Hardt selection and proper ordinary uniformization resolve monomial time while retaining real parameters;bounded finite path family and fixed boxes. Retimed paths need not remain definable;not a uniform theorem for arbitrary moving endpoints/scales.
named_results.conditions: Hardt selection and proper ordinary uniformization resolve monomial time while retaining real parameters;bounded finite path family and fixed boxes. Retimed paths need not remain definable;not a uniform theorem for arbitrary moving endpoints/scales.

named_results.statement: For recursively Hermitian matrix-defined marked kernel,accessible points in any fixed normalized radius have minimum eigenvalues at least minus o(1).
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Generic fixed centre and all localization hypotheses;closure kernel is semidefinite. No finite-scale exact PSD certificate,explicit convergence rate or simultaneous unbounded-radius/vanishing-scale guarantee.
named_results.conditions: Generic fixed centre and all localization hypotheses;closure kernel is semidefinite. No finite-scale exact PSD certificate,explicit convergence rate or simultaneous unbounded-radius/vanishing-scale guarantee.

named_results.title_tex: Power bounds and generic Puiseux preparation
named_results.statement: Globally subanalytic positive functions admit uniform power-exponent bounds and finite generic joint Puiseux preparation;fibrewise residual-distance correction follows by subanalytic powers.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Uniform exponents differ from thresholds,which may depend on fixed auxiliary parameters. Finite families and finite jets can share a generic box;parameters cannot silently move with scale. Empty fibres give positive residual lower bounds instead of corrections.
named_results.conditions: Uniform exponents differ from thresholds,which may depend on fixed auxiliary parameters. Finite families and finite jets can share a generic box;parameters cannot silently move with scale. Empty fibres give positive residual lower bounds instead of corrections.

named_results.statement: Parameterized projective algebraic components/maps can be represented by marked projective families after generic restrictions and modifications.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Track actual Hilbert/Chow component,branches and graph resolution before scaling;bounded algebraic data mean finite number/degree in fibres,not bounds on coefficients,scale matrices or inverses.
named_results.conditions: Track actual Hilbert/Chow component,branches and graph resolution before scaling;bounded algebraic data mean finite number/degree in fibres,not bounds on coefficients,scale matrices or inverses.

named_results.statement: Open kernels of locally pseudoconvex open sets remain locally pseudoconvex.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Kernel uses eventual inclusion of a neighbourhood of each point,not pointwise eventual membership. Hartogs figures and slight enlargement permit varying holomorphic charts;retain local ambient manifold and compactness hypotheses.
named_results.conditions: Kernel uses eventual inclusion of a neighbourhood of each point,not pointwise eventual membership. Hartogs figures and slight enlargement permit varying holomorphic charts;retain local ambient manifold and compactness hypotheses.

named_results.statement: In bounded projective charts,limits and open kernels after analytic-parameter polynomial-fibre rescaling are semialgebraic and depend on finitely many parameter Taylor/Puiseux terms.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Puiseux scale and inverse-power bounds;fibre-preserving correction with slack t^A,residual t^B and Btheta>A+1 controls normalized error. Merely subanalytic coefficients give only subanalytic conclusion. Existence does not supply effective truncation order,rate or cost.
named_results.conditions: Puiseux scale and inverse-power bounds;fibre-preserving correction with slack t^A,residual t^B and Btheta>A+1 controls normalized error. Merely subanalytic coefficients give only subanalytic conclusion. Existence does not supply effective truncation order,rate or cost.

named_results.statement: Bounded globally subanalytic tests jointly continuous in space and uniformly Lipschitz there have generic joint compact-uniform limits as scale tends zero.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Delete a closed lower-dimensional parameter exception per finite requested family;countably many requests may need separate boxes. A moving parameter path is not licensed by a fixed-parameter limit alone.
named_results.conditions: Delete a closed lower-dimensional parameter exception per finite requested family;countably many requests may need separate boxes. A moving parameter path is not licensed by a fixed-parameter limit alone.

named_results.statement: For fixed rescaling R_t independent of centre,generic recentred upper limits and open kernels lose dependence on the real translation coordinate.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Need normalized joint distance tests;when scale depends on centre,normalize first. No replacement by pointwise offset tests or arbitrary moving real centres.
named_results.conditions: Need normalized joint distance tests;when scale depends on centre,normalize first. No replacement by pointwise offset tests or arbitrary moving real centres.

named_results.statement: A bounded globally subanalytic two-scale function with iterated limit has the same fixed-parameter limit along e=t^N for every sufficiently large integer N.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Finite families/radii/accuracies share an exponent threshold after preparation;small-scale thresholds may depend on fixed parameters. Does not identify arbitrary simultaneous e,t approaches.
named_results.conditions: Finite families/radii/accuracies share an exponent threshold after preparation;small-scale thresholds may depend on fixed parameters. Does not identify arbitrary simultaneous e,t approaches.

named_results.statement: Polynomial maxima over bounded closed hole fibres give the required plurisubharmonic logarithmic envelope in a pseudoconvex complement.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Proper closed hole set,locally bounded fibres and nonvanishing leading/monic test coefficients;finite-map/branch treatment needed. Does not assume whole vertical fibre is a disk or ignore infinity.
named_results.conditions: Proper closed hole set,locally bounded fibres and nonvanishing leading/monic test coefficients;finite-map/branch treatment needed. Does not assume whole vertical fibre is a disk or ignore infinity.

named_results.statement: Holes with one-sided disk boundary limits inside a full-box relative proper divisor remain in that divisor.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Smooth proper family,holomorphic divisor container defined over the whole box,nonzero fibre equations. Harmonic measure of logarithmic polynomial envelope supplies trapping;one vertical ray is insufficient.
named_results.conditions: Smooth proper family,holomorphic divisor container defined over the whole box,nonzero fibre equations. Harmonic measure of logarithmic polynomial envelope supplies trapping;one vertical ray is insufficient.

named_results.statement: Holes constrained by a proper divisor on a nonpluripolar interior parameter slice stay constrained over the connected base.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Full relative divisor and locally pseudoconvex open set;maximally totally real slice can be nonpluripolar. Requires original container,not a new divisor selected independently on each approach.
named_results.conditions: Full relative divisor and locally pseudoconvex open set;maximally totally real slice can be nonpluripolar. Requires original container,not a new divisor selected independently on each approach.

named_results.title_tex: Tangency propagation in a connected fibre
named_results.statement: One available patch and one-sided hole control extend availability across a connected central fibre outside its divisor.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Holomorphic submersion,connected fibre minus proper analytic divisor,local pseudoconvexity and relative containers. Plurisubharmonic radius and strong maximum propagate along paths;no disconnected-fibre shortcut.
named_results.conditions: Holomorphic submersion,connected fibre minus proper analytic divisor,local pseudoconvexity and relative containers. Plurisubharmonic radius and strong maximum propagate along paths;no disconnected-fibre shortcut.

named_results.title_tex: Analyticity of a thin pseudoconcave set
named_results.statement: A closed subanalytic pseudoconcave subset of complex n-manifold with real dimension at most2n-2 is analytic of pure codimension1 or empty.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Vajaitu q=1 with locally finite Hausdorff measure via uniformization;in complex dimension1 the set is locally finite. Real codimension alone without pseudoconvex complement is not enough.
named_results.conditions: Vajaitu q=1 with locally finite Hausdorff measure via uniformization;in complex dimension1 the set is locally finite. Real codimension alone without pseudoconvex complement is not enough.

named_results.title_tex: A relative divisor containing a proper subset
named_results.statement: A proper analytic subset in projective fibres can be put in a relative divisor after suitable generic shrinking.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Smooth proper projective family,connected fibres,coherent ideal twist and cohomology/base-change hypotheses;each fibre section must be nonzero. Not just one ambient homogeneous equation that may vanish identically on a limiting fibre.
named_results.conditions: Smooth proper projective family,connected fibres,coherent ideal twist and cohomology/base-change hypotheses;each fibre section must be nonzero. Not just one ambient homogeneous equation that may vanish identically on a limiting fibre.

named_results.statement: Uniform bounded algebraic fibre data allow generic relative algebraic containers of uniformly bounded degree and controlled limits.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Use elimination and actual Chow cycles retaining fibre dimension;generic real walls support only the appropriate transverse complex continuation. No unproved universal coefficient/scale bound.
named_results.conditions: Use elimination and actual Chow cycles retaining fibre dimension;generic real walls support only the appropriate transverse complex continuation. No unproved universal coefficient/scale bound.

named_results.statement: If an open locally pseudoconvex subanalytic region in a smooth proper projective family has bounded-data algebraic holes and a good open base region,proper-divisor hole structure propagates through the connected projection domain.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Whole connected compact fibres,full relative containers and all boundary/interior tests. Generic wall argument plus thin analyticity handles remaining codimension>=2;whole-fibre holes are excluded by definition of projection domain.
named_results.conditions: Whole connected compact fibres,full relative containers and all boundary/interior tests. Generic wall argument plus thin analyticity handles remaining codimension>=2;whole-fibre holes are excluded by definition of projection domain.

named_results.statement: A fixed full-box divisor container that works on the good region continues to contain all holes over the connected parameter domain.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Every irreducible hole component must dominate base when full-fibre holes are absent. Do not substitute unrelated fibrewise containers or omit properness of the fixed one.
named_results.conditions: Every irreducible hole component must dominate base when full-fibre holes are absent. Do not substitute unrelated fibrewise containers or omit properness of the fixed one.

named_results.title_tex: A section detects the projection domain
named_results.statement: A section off the fixed divisor detects the pseudoconvex projection parameter domain;its boundary stays outside the projected open incidence.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Section exists and remains off the full relative container in a box;use prior projective propagation. Not an arbitrary chosen local section with changing images/holes.
named_results.conditions: Section exists and remains off the full relative container in a box;use prior projective propagation. Not an arbitrary chosen local section with changing images/holes.

named_results.statement: Quasi-projective ordinary universal cover is equivalent to a finite etale Galois abelian-base holomorphic bundle with simply connected projective fibre,and to C^m times such F;general infinite etale Galois cover has the stated abelian-cover pullback description.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Normal connected projective X;zero-boundary OpenAI logabundance supplies old smooth-abundance premise. General-cover assertion is only one direction. Bundle need not be product and deck transformations need not be algebraic.
named_results.conditions: Normal connected projective X;zero-boundary OpenAI logabundance supplies old smooth-abundance premise. General-cover assertion is only one direction. Bundle need not be product and deck transformations need not be algebraic.

named_results.statement: Smooth projective n-fold with ordinary universal cover C^n has a finite etale Galois cover by an abelian variety.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: n>=0;use quasi-projective corollary and compact connected fibre embedding in C^n,whose coordinates force fibre to a point. Does not address arbitrary nonprojective quotients or quasi-projective base.
named_results.conditions: n>=0;use quasi-projective corollary and compact connected fibre embedding in C^n,whose coordinates force fibre to a point. Does not address arbitrary nonprojective quotients or quasi-projective base.

named_results.statement: The resolved open set V in its smooth projective ambient Y is locally pseudoconvex.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Actual functorial resolution of normal cover and compact projective resolution quotient. Hartogs extension to that quotient and evenly covered sheet give first-exit contradiction;not a general claim for every ambient open subset.
named_results.conditions: Actual functorial resolution of normal cover and compact projective resolution quotient. Hartogs extension to that quotient and evenly covered sheet give first-exit contradiction;not a general claim for every ambient open subset.

named_results.statement: The recursive positive-Hermitian tower P is contractible,Stein,bounded-realizable and has proper intrinsic Kobayashi distance.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Schur-slack coordinates and explicit bounded chart;proper distance follows closed embedding into product Siegel spaces,not boundedness alone. Point case separated.
named_results.conditions: Schur-slack coordinates and explicit bounded chart;proper distance follows closed embedding into product Siegel spaces,not boundedness alone. Point case separated.

named_results.statement: Construct decaying sector-valued holomorphic guards on growing accessible parameter regions with high seed components and uniformly vanishing incidence-boundary values.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: h=exp(-alpha sum tr log(I-iM_j)),0<alpha<1/(2sum n_j);sector angle<pi/2;quadratic artificial-boundary correction chosen with a_i R_i^2<=1. Nonartificial boundary has no incidence;diagonal radii chosen only after fixed-box estimates.
named_results.conditions: h=exp(-alpha sum tr log(I-iM_j)),0<alpha<1/(2sum n_j);sector angle<pi/2;quadratic artificial-boundary correction chosen with a_i R_i^2<=1. Nonartificial boundary has no incidence;diagonal radii chosen only after fixed-box estimates.

named_results.statement: Distinct high-window fibre regions meeting V coincide,so their union is open with an intrinsic holomorphic submersion and maximal projective-minus-analytic fibres.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Compact incidence and finite local root projections with multiplicities;bounded plurisubharmonic trace plus strictness forces constancy on compact models minus analytic holes. Whole incidence,not a selected seed patch,required.
named_results.conditions: Compact incidence and finite local root projections with multiplicities;bounded plurisubharmonic trace plus strictness forces constancy on compact models minus analytic holes. Whole incidence,not a selected seed patch,required.

named_results.statement: Bounded holomorphic functions on moving open sets with uniformly vanishing internal-boundary values have locally uniform holomorphic subsequential limits after zero-extension in the prescribed sense.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: W12 cutoff and Rellich alone give only L2;circle traces/argument principle and moving-line equicontinuity needed for uniform conclusion. Sector<pi/2 plus moving nonzero seed excludes zero limit and eventually hidden holes;not exact continuity of every fixed-index zero extension.
named_results.conditions: W12 cutoff and Rellich alone give only L2;circle traces/argument principle and moving-line equicontinuity needed for uniform conclusion. Sector<pi/2 plus moving nonzero seed excludes zero limit and eventually hidden holes;not exact continuity of every fixed-index zero extension.

named_results.statement: Holomorphic maps from exhausting connected domains into V with normalized seed tending an interior point are eventually trapped on every compact in the chosen high-window chart,and their parameter maps have normal limits into P.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Guard boundary vanishing over entire paths,localization upper containment and semidefinite limit tests;harmonic minimum with strictly positive seed makes image strict. No conclusion from pointwise coordinate bounds alone.
named_results.conditions: Guard boundary vanishing over entire paths,localization upper containment and semidefinite limit tests;harmonic minimum with strictly positive seed makes image strict. No conclusion from pointwise coordinate bounds alone.

named_results.statement: Inverse normalized charts send each compact subset of P into one fixed compact region of the intrinsic quotient for all large indices.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Diagonal contradiction chooses a failing fixed earlier chart then a sufficiently late one and invokes trapping. Varying-chart compact containment alone is insufficient to obtain a global inverse.
named_results.conditions: Diagonal contradiction chooses a failing fixed earlier chart then a sufficiently late one and invokes trapping. Varying-chart compact containment alone is insufficient to obtain a global inverse.

named_results.statement: Intrinsic map on smooth resolution descends uniquely to an equivariant holomorphic map from normal universal cover U to M with connected compactifiable semialgebraic fibres.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Proper modification with compact connected fibres,normal removable extension and mu_*O=O;bounded target coordinates. Finite-cover equivariance and actual incidence image retained;no algebraicity of deck maps required.
named_results.conditions: Proper modification with compact connected fibres,normal removable extension and mu_*O=O;bounded target coordinates. Finite-cover equivariance and actual incidence image retained;no algebraicity of deck maps required.

named_results.statement: Construct the intrinsic equivariant transverse quotient M,contractible Stein and bounded-realizable,with complex-spanning complete fields and a flat map from U with normal compactifiable fibres.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Quotient is built before transverse image discreteness. Prepare normal fibres,fibrewise bimeromorphic resolution and canonical Whitney-stratum submersions on full families before scales/translates. Proper compact quotient-family consequences additionally require discrete free image,proved later.
named_results.conditions: Quotient is built before transverse image discreteness. Prepare normal fibres,fibrewise bimeromorphic resolution and canonical Whitney-stratum submersions on full families before scales/translates. Proper compact quotient-family consequences additionally require discrete free image,proved later.

named_results.statement: Constant-Levi-rank real algebraic boundary patches have complex Levi-null plaques open in irreducible algebraic varieties of controlled dimension/degree.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Regular real algebraic hypersurface with pseudoconvex side;polarization and maximal isotropic monomial spaces. Generic parameter and marked component choices;not an arbitrary smooth or merely definable boundary.
named_results.conditions: Regular real algebraic hypersurface with pseudoconvex side;polarization and maximal isotropic monomial spaces. Generic parameter and marked component choices;not an arbitrary smooth or merely definable boundary.

named_results.statement: Local contact quotient yields a symmetric meromorphic period matrix H on projective plaque models and the quadratic Schur epigraph for transverse first scaling.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Darboux normalization and full-rank evaluation;weights2 for s,1 for w. Matrix sign and factor normalization fixed by contact kernel;cannot pick arbitrary higher Taylor terms or assume holomorphic H across its poles initially.
named_results.conditions: Darboux normalization and full-rank evaluation;weights2 for s,1 for w. Matrix sign and factor normalization fixed by contact kernel;cannot pick arbitrary higher Taylor terms or assume holomorphic H across its poles initially.

named_results.title_tex: The whole seed fibre has a Bergman function
named_results.statement: The entire quadratic positive seed-fibre component has nonzero L2 Bergman evaluation.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Explicit Cayley map to a ball after positive-form normalization and Jacobian pullback;extend by zero only to other components. A function on a proper open part does not establish the Bergman space of the full component.
named_results.conditions: Explicit Cayley map to a ball after positive-form normalization and Jacobian pullback;extend by zero only to other components. A function on a proper open part does not establish the Bergman space of the full component.

named_results.statement: The whole first parameter domain is exactly the positive Schur epigraph over a connected semialgebraic locally pseudoconvex V2.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Whole-fibre Berndtsson logBergman positivity and nonzero seed exclude bad chambers containing complex affine lines;Cayley removes meromorphic poles. Proper divisor/tangency/thin-hole arguments fill exceptional holes,not Boolean sign selection alone.
named_results.conditions: Whole-fibre Berndtsson logBergman positivity and nonzero seed exclude bad chambers containing complex affine lines;Cayley removes meromorphic poles. Proper divisor/tangency/thin-hole arguments fill exceptional holes,not Boolean sign selection alone.

named_results.statement: With joint Puiseux scale matrices and inverse-power bounds,locally bounded rescaled holomorphic functions have finite Taylor polynomial limits on all bounded complex boxes,including derivatives.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Holomorphic functions on one fixed neighbourhood;enough uniform Taylor orders and all generic real-parameter jets. Negative Laurent coefficients vanish by boundedness on a nonempty open set;pointwise Puiseux or moving domains do not suffice.
named_results.conditions: Holomorphic functions on one fixed neighbourhood;enough uniform Taylor orders and all generic real-parameter jets. Negative Laurent coefficients vanish by boundedness on a nonempty open set;pointwise Puiseux or moving domains do not suffice.

named_results.statement: Normalize the varying Siegel matrix by T=(ImH_seed)^1/2 to obtain a polynomial limiting symmetric matrix tau with strictly positive imaginary part on lower tower.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: T and inverse need joint Puiseux/power control;Cayley normality and positive seed then harmonic minimum. Square-root comparisons use AA^T,not matrix commutativity.
named_results.conditions: T and inverse need joint Puiseux/power control;Cayley normality and positive seed then harmonic minimum. Square-root comparisons use AA^T,not matrix commutativity.

named_results.statement: Construct projective window families,full relative divisor containers,a recursive strict-positive matrix tower P,scales and polynomial triangular real-centre ratio symmetries with accessible upper containment.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Compose/resolvе marked families before scaling;all upper-half-disk approaches needed for hole trapping. Normalize joint tests before recentring;choose e=t^N after finite pole/test requirements. Fixed S and all bounded recenterings allow localization;no effective N/rate or finite constructor asserted.
named_results.conditions: Compose/resolvе marked families before scaling;all upper-half-disk approaches needed for hole trapping. Normalize joint tests before recentring;choose e=t^N after finite pole/test requirements. Fixed S and all bounded recenterings allow localization;no effective N/rate or finite constructor asserted.

named_results.statement: The tower P is diffeomorphic to R^(2d),Stein and biholomorphic to a bounded domain,with complete real holomorphic fields complex-spanning each tangent.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Recursive strict Im M_j positivity,Schur slack and logdet exhaustion;explicit first-column Cayley coordinates recover original variables. Complex spanning is weaker than real transitivity;later group argument supplies symmetry.
named_results.conditions: Recursive strict Im M_j positivity,Schur slack and logdet exhaustion;explicit first-column Cayley coordinates recover original variables. Complex spanning is weaker than real transitivity;later group argument supplies symmetry.

named_results.statement: Uniformly bounded holomorphic functions on an open reduced affine algebraic set are locally equicontinuous and have compact-uniform convergent subsequences;limit reaching unit modulus inside is constant on connected component.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Works before smoothness,including nonnormal points;finite Noether projection and coalescing root coefficients plus Cauchy control. Weakly holomorphic on normalization is not automatically holomorphic downstairs.
named_results.conditions: Works before smoothness,including nonnormal points;finite Noether projection and coalescing root coefficients plus Cauchy control. Weakly holomorphic on normalization is not automatically holomorphic downstairs.

named_results.statement: A nonpoint bounded open reduced affine set with proper discrete cocompact holomorphic action is a smooth positive-dimensional connected complex manifold.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: No semialgebraicity used at this step. Polynomial peak avoids ambient singular/other-component locus,translated Montel limits force image into one regular patch;finite stabilizers allowed.
named_results.conditions: No semialgebraicity used at this step. Polynomial peak avoids ambient singular/other-component locus,translated Montel limits force image into one regular patch;finite stabilizers allowed.

named_results.statement: Its intrinsic Kobayashi distance is finite,proper and induces ordinary topology.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Bounded coordinates separate points and give distance lower bound;compact orbit representatives give uniform intrinsic balls and controlled chain lengths. Not properness for arbitrary bounded domains without cocompactness.
named_results.conditions: Bounded coordinates separate points and give distance lower bound;compact orbit representatives give uniform intrinsic balls and controlled chain lengths. Not properness for arbitrary bounded domains without cocompactness.

named_results.statement: A continuous deformation of closed analytic discs initially inside U stays inside when all boundaries remain in a fixed compact subset of U.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Holomorphic on interiors,continuous closed discs and smooth ambient chart;uniform collar estimates and proper intrinsic distance. Does not require extension past boundary or arbitrary noncompact boundary control.
named_results.conditions: Holomorphic on interiors,continuous closed discs and smooth ambient chart;uniform collar estimates and proper intrinsic distance. Does not require extension past boundary or arbitrary noncompact boundary control.

named_results.title_tex: Complex rank of a boundary cell
named_results.statement: A real-analytic semialgebraic boundary cell either has generic complex tangent span equal to ambient complex tangent or lies in a proper complex algebraic subset.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Nash algebraic rank/transcendence argument in characteristic zero;generic cell/regular locus and ambient irreducible component tracked. Not a dichotomy for arbitrary real-analytic nonalgebraic cells.
named_results.conditions: Nash algebraic rank/transcendence argument in characteristic zero;generic cell/regular locus and ambient irreducible component tracked. Not a dichotomy for arbitrary real-analytic nonalgebraic cells.

named_results.statement: Bounded semialgebraic parameter/scale functions have generic jointly analytic extensions after power ramification.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Finite collections can share exponent and neighbourhood;countable tests only yield full-measure good points with possibly individual exponents/neighbourhoods. No common countable analytic box claimed.
named_results.conditions: Finite collections can share exponent and neighbourhood;countable tests only yield full-measure good points with possibly individual exponents/neighbourhoods. No common countable analytic box claimed.

named_results.statement: At almost every point of a full-complex-rank boundary cell,capped distance to excluded normal offsets has a joint locally uniform Lipschitz limit with a closed excluded cone F containing0.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Nash normal-graph coordinates and bounded parameter boxes;construct countably rational offset tests then use Lipschitz continuity. F may initially be all R^k;noncollapse is separate.
named_results.conditions: Nash normal-graph coordinates and bounded parameter boxes;construct countably rational offset tests then use Lipschitz continuity. F may initially be all R^k;noncollapse is separate.

named_results.statement: There is a good boundary point with k linearly independent supporting conormals and global holomorphic peak functions,while generic joint offset limits still hold.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Weighted polynomial/exponential peak maximizers,critical affine-bundle coordinates and Fubini transfer full-measure good parameters. Not every exposed or arbitrarily chosen support point is known good.
named_results.conditions: Weighted polynomial/exponential peak maximizers,critical affine-bundle coordinates and Fubini transfer full-measure good parameters. Not every exposed or arbitrarily chosen support point is known good.

named_results.statement: Approaching analytic interior graphs produce full real-dimensional interior balls of radius c t at normal distance O(t) from the totally real boundary patch.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Bishop H2 contraction with fixed small alpha and positive regularization delta=t^2;endpoint centre map C1 full rank via boundary perturbation. The delta=0 limiting disc need not lie inside;no uniform estimate as alpha tends0.
named_results.conditions: Bishop H2 contraction with fixed small alpha and positive regularization delta=t^2;endpoint centre map C1 full rank via boundary perturbation. The delta=0 limiting disc need not lie inside;no uniform estimate as alpha tends0.

named_results.statement: The good-point excluded offset cone F is a proper subset of R^k.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Interior ct-balls lie at moving old parameters;use joint normalized distance convergence,not merely a fixed normal-slice limit. No explicit universal c or noncollapse scale supplied.
named_results.conditions: Interior ct-balls lie at moving old parameters;use joint normalized distance convergence,not merely a fixed normal-slice limit. No explicit universal c or noncollapse scale supplied.

named_results.title_tex: Two-sided convergence of the scaled sets
named_results.statement: Weighted tangential sqrt(t),normal t scalings have a nonempty open quadratic limit with eventual interior-compact inclusion and approximating excluded points for every limit-excluded point.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Old residual/t tends L(ImW)-Q(Z);joint offsets and both directions of set convergence required. A numerical picture or one-sided kernel inclusion is insufficient.
named_results.conditions: Old residual/t tends L(ImW)-Q(Z);joint offsets and both directions of set convergence required. A numerical picture or one-sided kernel inclusion is insufficient.

named_results.statement: U is biholomorphic to a quadratic Hermitian model over a nonempty connected open cone C,with independent strict support functionals and a bounded realization.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: C not initially assumed convex;k>=1,0 tangential dimension allowed. Independent peaks bound all normal coordinates and proper intrinsic distance controls inverses. One inverse-composition identity alone does not prove full global image;Hurwitz/local inverses plus excluded convergence do.
named_results.conditions: C not initially assumed convex;k>=1,0 tangential dimension allowed. Independent peaks bound all normal coordinates and proper intrinsic distance controls inverses. One inverse-composition identity alone does not prove full global image;Hurwitz/local inverses plus excluded convergence do.

named_results.statement: A bounded-realizable divisible model with real normal translations,unit tangential rotations and exponent1/2 positive weighted dilations is biholomorphic to a bounded symmetric domain.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Vey input includes axis point and proper discrete compact action,finite stabilizers allowed. Actual Cayley realization is given after strict supports. General S-domain natural theorem is broader than the selected Hermitian formal support endpoint;do not upgrade whole support statement to B.
named_results.conditions: Vey input includes axis point and proper discrete compact action,finite stabilizers allowed. Actual Cayley realization is given after strict supports. General S-domain natural theorem is broader than the selected Hermitian formal support endpoint;do not upgrade whole support statement to B.

named_results.statement: A nonempty connected bounded semialgebraic relative-open subset of a reduced complex affine variety with a proper discrete cocompact holomorphic action is smooth and biholomorphic to a bounded symmetric domain.
named_results.conditions_and_constants: Fixed affine embedding;ambient may be singular/nonnormal and quotient need not be smooth/projective;finite stabilizers and zero-dimensional point permitted. Only this selected main has matching registered Lean specification/actual source endpoint;no local build,human or full imported proof audit.
named_results.conditions: Fixed affine embedding;ambient may be singular/nonnormal and quotient need not be smooth/projective;finite stabilizers and zero-dimensional point permitted. Only this selected main has matching registered Lean specification/actual source endpoint;no local build,human or full imported proof audit.

methods.input: Polynomial residual small in one parameter fibre
methods.output: Nearby exact fibre solution close after inverse scaling
methods.conditions_and_nontransferability: Bounded-data subanalytic distance exponents and nonempty fibre;arbitrary nearest solution in another fibre invalid

methods.input: One fixed locally pseudoconvex physical region and normalized ratio matrices
methods.output: Accessible path upper containment through every bounded recentring
methods.conditions_and_nontransferability: Triangular real-polynomial blocks invertible everywhere and all finite-box jets,not one tested path

methods.input: Small-slope analytic boundary graphs and independent perturbation controls
methods.output: Interior disc centres with full real rank and noncollapse balls
methods.conditions_and_nontransferability: Fix schedule/alpha then scale limit,only then shrink exceptional arcs;no unjustified joint limit

methods.input: Projective compact fibres with bounded-data holes and local pseudoconvexity
methods.output: Continue one divisor container across boundary and connected base
methods.conditions_and_nontransferability: Container defined on full box,proper each fibre;actual Chow cycle limits,not vanishing limit equations

methods.input: Matrix-positive tower and controlled accessible outer region
methods.output: Holomorphic decay separates high seed charts from all internal boundaries
methods.conditions_and_nontransferability: Matrix log sector angle<pi/2 and alpha bound;no numerical finite-scale PSD guarantee

methods.input: Bounded holomorphic functions on moving regions with small boundary values
methods.output: Locally uniform holomorphic limit and eventually compact containment
methods.conditions_and_nontransferability: Rellich L2 alone insufficient;circle trace/argument principle and seed sector needed

methods.input: Exhausting forward charts and guard trapping
methods.output: Two-sided limiting biholomorphism onto intrinsic quotient
methods.conditions_and_nontransferability: Contain inverse images in one fixed compact chart;one-composition equality or moving compact sets insufficient

methods.input: Countable images of meromorphic compact-incidence levels
methods.output: Locally finite closed level sets force discrete transverse closure
methods.conditions_and_nontransferability: Countability not discreteness;properness and exact whole-level image identity essential

methods.input: Finitely generated Lie-group image with finite isotropy
methods.output: Finite-index free action from torsionfree adjoint image
methods.conditions_and_nontransferability: Ad may have kernel;must use complex-spanning fields,identity derivative and finite-order linearization

methods.input: Normal projective fibre family,common resolution,saturated integral H1
methods.output: Relative torus torsor and proper affine universal base
methods.conditions_and_nontransferability: Finite H1 kernel upgraded only after torsionfree proof;no chosen origin or original torus isotriviality

methods.input: Simply connected normal projective fibres and nonextendable polarization
methods.output: Semialgebraic polarized-isomorphism loci via graph degree and integral c1
methods.conditions_and_nontransferability: Line bundle need not be definable;normality and Pic0=0 are indispensable

methods.input: Proper cocompact countable group on Euclidean-homeomorphic contractible manifold
methods.output: No proper nonempty invariant closed finite-CW-homotopy subset
methods.conditions_and_nontransferability: Finite stabilizers allowed;local finiteness plus bounded-distance proper homotopy before degree argument

methods.input: Varying locally pseudoconvex domains with fixed compact tests
methods.output: Pseudoconvex limiting open domain
methods.conditions_and_nontransferability: Neighbourhood eventual inclusion,not individual-point eventual membership

methods.input: Bounded holomorphic functions on reduced affine singular spaces
methods.output: Local equicontinuity via finite projection and coalescing-root bounds
methods.conditions_and_nontransferability: Do not replace downstairs holomorphic functions by arbitrary weakly holomorphic normalization data

methods.input: Approaching positive-regularization analytic discs
methods.output: Moving-parameter interior balls exclude collapsed normal cone
methods.conditions_and_nontransferability: Joint parameter/offset convergence required;fixed-slice convergence cannot transfer moving balls

methods.input: Independent support peaks plus proper intrinsic metric
methods.output: Full global biholomorphism to weighted quadratic model
methods.conditions_and_nontransferability: All normal coordinates bounded,interior inclusion and excluded-point approximation both needed

methods.input: Independent positive support forms on connected open quadratic cone model
methods.output: Explicit bounded Cayley realization in intrinsic dimension
methods.conditions_and_nontransferability: Initial cone need not be convex;axis and invariances still needed before Vey;constants non-effective

methods.input: Compact aspherical negative-Chern quotient with bounded contractible universal cover
methods.output: Eliminate discrete residual factor in symmetric splitting
methods.conditions_and_nontransferability: Complete Bergman product metric,no Euclidean factors and complex-spanning complete fields;separate from Vey route

original_history_scopes.title: Kollar-Pardon semialgebraic universal covers, explicit arXiv v2
original_history_scopes.selected_scope: Conjecture2 and Theorem3/Remark4 statements PDF1-2;Theorem20 and proof22 PDF10-12,selected Chow setup;Question25/26 PDF13. Dependencies14/15 and full earlier proof not read.
original_history_scopes.source_fact: Theorem20 assumes smooth projective base with contractible universal cover,normal projective source and entire induced pullback semialgebraic projective-open;concludes a holomorphic fibre bundle. Initial proof passes to finite base cover to connect pullback,not an extra connected-fibre premise. Theorem3 has an irreducible bounded symmetric domain of dimension>=2 and free compact action;disk case has a separate caveat. Question25 asks bounded affine semialgebraic-domain symmetry.
original_history_scopes.comparison: Old bundle theorem is used in F058 compact step after actual Albanese and entire pullback are supplied. It does not itself construct the general transverse quotient or remove group/specialness conditions.
original_history_scopes.unverified: Whole theorem proof dependencies/topological lemmas,all versions and historical closure remain unreviewed.

original_history_scopes.title: Vey divisible S-domains, original1970 scan
original_history_scopes.selected_scope: Printed479-481/PDF2-4:proper discrete cocompact definition,S-domain symmetries,Theorem1 and following symmetry consequence,zero-block conventions. Full proof unread.
original_history_scopes.source_fact: Divisibility requires compact sweeping set and proper action with discrete topology;freeness is not stated. An S-domain is bounded-realizable,meets its zero tangential block,and is invariant under all real normal translations,unit scalar tangential rotations and weighted positive dilations. Theorem1 gives homogeneity;the following paragraph states symmetry using earlier results. Exponent1/2 and zero tangential block are explicit cases.
original_history_scopes.comparison: F058 bounded manuscript must first construct its global model,bounded realization,axis point and all invariances;Vey is not a classifier for arbitrary sampled real feasible regions.
